issue_context.title: br: support restart task at the same storage directory after stop a log backup task
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Support the blow feature:
- start a log-backup task with the command `br log start --task-name=t1 -s "storage/dir" -u {IP}:{PORT}`
- stop this log-backup task with the command `br log stop --task-name=t2 -u {IP}:{PORT}`
- restart this log-backup task with the command `br log start --task-name=t3 -s "storage/dir" -u {IP}:{PORT}` at the same storage and the backup data from the `checkpoint-ts` from last task.
